snippet.title: Tonton ini sebelum nekat terobos rel! ⚠️🚂 #kokdilarang #keretaapi #safety
snippet.description:
Di perlintasan kereta api Gayamsari, palang pintu yang tetap tertutup sering memicu bahaya saat pengendara nekat menerobos.

Kejadian di Semarang pada 16 Januari 2025 ini menunjukkan risiko fatal akibat tidak mematuhi aturan di perlintasan sebidang. Seorang kurir yang mengejar target dan warga yang menyelinap di bawah palang pintu adalah contoh nyata bagaimana urgensi sering mengalahkan keselamatan. Peristiwa ini berakhir tragis ketika seorang pemotor tertabrak kereta di jalur ganda tanpa palang, sebuah pengingat keras bahwa waktu tidak sebanding dengan nyawa.

Memahami bahaya menerobos palang kereta sangat penting bagi pengguna jalan. Jalur ganda sering kali menyembunyikan kereta yang datang dari arah berlawanan setelah kereta pertama lewat. Selalu waspada dan pastikan jalur benar-benar aman sebelum melintas, karena sistem keamanan manual sering kali tidak cukup melindungi kita dari kelalaian sesaat.

snippet.title: POWERFUL NOR'EASTER SLAMS OCEAN CITY, Maryland — Downtown UNDER WATER on Thanksgiving
snippet.description:
A powerful nor'easter slammed Ocean City, Maryland, on Thanksgiving Day, Thursday, November 26, 2026, bringing wind gusts up to 60 mph, coastal flooding and storm damage to the resort town and Maryland's Eastern Shore. Officials had warned that flooding could rival Superstorm Sandy in 2012, and residents in low-lying areas were told to move their vehicles to higher ground the night before.

Strong winds tore the roof off the East Winds West condominium building on 70th Street, damaging four units and closing part of the street, though no injuries were reported. Another roof blew off a building on 45th Street, power lines came down near 94th Street, and debris reached Coastal Highway. Downtown Ocean City and the south end near the inlet flooded, Philadelphia Avenue became impassable, westbound Route 50 bridge traffic was restricted, and drivers were sent to Route 90. Waves reached and topped the seawall while thick sea foam covered the boardwalk. In nearby Ocean Pines, a tree crashed through a home.

The morning high tide came in near five feet instead of the forecast six, but the extreme water returned for a second high tide cycle. Delmarva Power outages peaked at about 14,000 customers in Maryland on Thursday, and by Friday morning Worcester County was down to just 42 outages. As the storm pulled away, the wind shift sent major coastal flooding into the Chesapeake Bay in Dorchester, Wicomico and Somerset counties.

In this video, we cover the flooding and roof damage in Ocean City, road closures, power outages, the cleanup on the boardwalk and inlet, and why this second nor'easter in two months is a serious problem for a beach already eroded in September. A $25.7 million Army Corps of Engineers beach renourishment project will not start pumping sand until mid-March, leaving Ocean City exposed for the rest of the winter storm season.

Downtown Ocean City and the south end near the inlet flooded, Philadelphia Avenue became impassable, westbound Route 50 bridge traffic was restricted, and drivers were sent to Route 90. Waves reached and topped the seawall while thick sea foam covered the boardwalk. In nearby Ocean Pines, a tree crashed through a home.

The morning high tide came in near five feet instead of the forecast six, but the extreme water returned for a second high tide cycle. Delmarva Power outages peaked at about 14,000 customers in Maryland on Thursday, and by Friday morning Worcester County was down to just 42 outages. As the storm pulled away, the wind shift sent major coastal flooding into the Chesapeake Bay in Dorchester, Wicomico and Somerset counties.

In this video, we cover the flooding and roof damage in Ocean City, road closures, power outages, the cleanup on the boardwalk and inlet, and why this second nor'easter in two months is a serious problem for a beach already eroded in September. A $25.7 million Army Corps of Engineers beach renourishment project will not start pumping sand until mid-March, leaving Ocean City exposed for the rest of the winter storm season.

This local Japanese restaurant has become a neighborhood favorite for its incredibly fresh sashimi, robata charcoal-grilled seafood, and ever-changing menu based on the day's catch.  In this Japan food documentary, we follow Hide-san, who spent 12 years working at Tokyo’s legendary Tsukiji Fish Market after graduating from culinary school. There, he developed a deep understanding of Japan’s seafood industry before following his passion, becoming a fisherman himself and opening his own Japanese izakaya 17 years ago.  The day begins early in the morning when Hide-san delivers freshly caught fish to the restaurant. His team must then decide how to prepare each fish, using different Japanese cooking techniques to bring out its natural flavors. Hide-san travels to fishing ports across Japan, building relationships with local Japanese fishermen and seafood suppliers. His longstanding connections from his days at Tsukiji Fish Market also give him access to exceptional seafood. For Hide-san, sourcing the best fish in Japan comes down to something that money cannot buy: trust earned through decades of working together.

Es ist das erste serienmäßig mit Zirkon-Hyperschallraketen ausgestattete U-Boot der russischen Flotte. Während Moskau seine strategischen Fähigkeiten unter Wasser ausbaut, offenbaren insbesondere die regionalen Flotten erhebliche Schwächen im Kampf gegen ukrainische Drohnen. Eine rund 800.000 Soldaten starke, langfristig vom Westen finanzierte Armee könnte aus ukrainischer Sicht entscheidend sein. Pada trik semacam ini, baterai dan motor kecil bisa saja disembunyikan di dalam rangka atau alas. Karet gelang dan paku hanya menjadi bagian dari ilusi untuk mengelabui penglihatan.

snippet.title: Błąd, który popełnia każdy w japońskim sklepie 😅 #japonia #kultura
snippet.description:
Płacenie w Japonii rządzi się swoimi zasadami, o których warto pamiętać przy kasie. Sprawdź, jak uniknąć wpadki w sklepie.

Podczas zakupów w tokijskie sklepy turyści często popełniają błąd, podając pieniądze bezpośrednio do ręki kasjera. W Japonii gotówkę oraz resztę kładzie się na specjalnej tacce. To drobny gest, który pokazuje szacunek do sprzedawcy i jest kluczowym elementem codziennej obsługi klienta.

Zrozumienie, jak wygląda etykieta w Japonii, pozwala na bardziej świadome podróżowanie i unikanie niezręcznych sytuacji przy kasie. Ta prosta zasada kultury Japonii sprawia, że interakcje stają się płynne i zrozumiałe dla obu stron.

Napisz w komentarzu, czy wiedziałeś o tym zwyczaju przed wizytą w Azji! Subskrybuj kanał po więcej ciekawostek o życiu w Japonii.

snippet.title: 💕Wedding Diaries: Juron Edition✨ #minivlog #dailyvlog #wedding #fun #vlog #assamesevlogs #love
snippet.description:
It's Juron Day! 💍❤️ The wedding celebrations have officially begun!

Today's vlog is all about my girlfriend's elder sister's Juron ceremony. Starting the day with my Juron outfit check, followed by meeting the beautiful bride-to-be and, of course, a little outfit check with my favourite people. ✨

Then the beautiful Juron ceremony begins! From Mainaba's grand entry into the wedding hall to the traditional rituals, family moments and endless photographs, everything was so special. 🥹❤️

And what's a wedding celebration without delicious food? 😋 We explored so many starters, enjoyed pani puri, tried different desserts and then moved on to the main course. Everything was so tasty, but the mango mousse definitely stole the show! 🥭

Finally, the Juron celebrations came to an end, and I'm back in my hotel room.

One celebration down, and the BIG WEDDING DAY is next! ❤️

Stay tuned for the next vlog. See you there! 👋
